title: Download a byte range
description: Read a portion of a file without fetching its entire contents.

sections.title: Request an inclusive range
paragraphs: Replace FILE_ID with an existing file that has at least 1,024 bytes. Range offsets are inclusive, so 0–1023 requests exactly 1,024 bytes.
sections.code:
export FILE_ID="<existing-file-id>"
curl --fail --dump-header range-headers.txt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOFT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Range: bytes=0-1023" \
  "$LOFT_API/v1/files/$FILE_ID/content" -o first-kib.bin
wc -c first-kib.bin

sections.title: Verify the response
paragraphs: A valid partial response has status 206 and a Content-Range header. When reading a file in multiple requests, use If-Match with its ETag so a concurrent edit cannot mix versions.
